note: The raw PoC bytes are passed directly as the HPACK header block to the decoder.
The first byte 0x00 selects a literal header field with a literal name and advances to the name length field.
The PoC supplies a name length of zero. The decoder accepts it and does not reject an empty header name before adding the item to the header list.
The header name object is built with name.len equal to zero while name.ptr still points into the input buffer.
The PoC provides a one-byte value length followed by the byte x, so the literal header is otherwise well-formed.
The empty header name is stored in the decoded list. Later consumers use n.len == 0 as the list terminator, so this injected entry truncates the header list.
